label: Direct dependencies on the latest allowed
means: Direct dependencies on the newest stable release old enough to take; one installed sooner is too new.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: every direct dependency on its newest stable release once that release is params.release_age_days old (default 14), so a broken or compromised release has time to be pulled first
source: state: package.json (root and workspaces) with its lockfile (package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm-lock.yaml or yarn.lock) and npm view <name> time --json

params.comment: repo (default GITHUB_REPOSITORY, then the origin remote), release_age_days (how old a release must be to count), own_action_owners (owners whose actions have no releases; default the repo's owner), dependency_label (the label on update PRs), branch (default main), last_n (merged update PRs read), install_workflow (default: the newest push run with an install step), adopters (owner/name repos that pin this one, for tools.adopters_latest_share; default none), adopter_cooldown_days (how old a tag of this repo must be before an adopter is judged against it; default 7, one weekly Dependabot run; 0 for the newest tag).

label: Dependencies a major behind
means: Direct dependencies whose newest allowed release is a newer major, less a major a Dependabot ignore holds.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: no direct dependency a major release behind its newest allowed one; near band: template default
source: state: npm view <name> time --json against the lockfile

label: Actions pinned to the latest allowed
means: Third-party actions whose pinned SHA is the commit of their newest release old enough to take.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: every third-party action on its newest allowed release, pinned to a full commit SHA as GitHub's security hardening guide recommends (docs.github.com/en/actions/security-for-github-actions/security-guides/security-hardening-for-github-actions)
source: state: uses: pins in .github/workflows and gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases; actions of params.own_action_owners (default the repo's owner) left out

label: Adopting repos within the cooldown of the newest tag
means: Adopters whose every pin of this repo is at or above its newest tag at least params.adopter_cooldown_days old.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: set 2026-11-04 (#236), redefined 2026-11-11: every adopter at or above the newest tag that is params.adopter_cooldown_days old. The grace is one weekly Dependabot run, the github-actions schedule templates/ci/dependabot.yml ships, so the default is 7 days. The newest tag itself is a bar no weekly run holds, so that goal could not be met. Dependabot's weekly github-actions run moves a SHA pin with a version comment
source: state: each params.adopters repo's .github/workflows uses: pins (gh api contents), this repo's version tags (gh api tags) and the committer date of each tag younger than that, highest version first, up to the first old enough (gh api git/commits). A pin no version tag names is behind; with no tag that old, the metric is not read

label: CI's Node is the current LTS
means: 1 when every setup-node step in the workflows asks for the newest LTS line; with none, the .nvmrc or .node-version.
goal_source: goal from Node.js, which recommends LTS releases for production (nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases)
source: state: each actions/setup-node step in .github/workflows (else .nvmrc or .node-version) and nodejs.org/dist/index.json

label: Oldest update waiting
means: Days since the oldest pending update to a direct dependency became old enough to take; 0 when none waits.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a weekly update run lands an allowed update within a week; near: two weeks
source: state: npm view <name> time --json against the lockfile

label: Open dependency PRs
means: Pull requests labeled as dependency updates that are open now.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: one grouped update PR at a time; near is Dependabot's default open-pull-requests-limit, five ("If five pull requests with version updates are open, no further pull requests are raised", docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/working-with-dependabot/dependabot-options-reference, read 2026-11-03)
source: state: gh pr list --label params.dependency_label (default dependencies, the label Dependabot adds to every PR) --state open

label: Oldest open dependency PR
means: Days the oldest open dependency PR has waited; 0 when none is open.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a weekly update PR merges within its week; near: two weeks
source: state: gh pr list --label params.dependency_label --state open

label: CI minutes on the latest dependency PR
means: Billed Actions minutes on the newest merged dependency PR, read now.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: set 2026-11-04; an update PR runs the repo's CI once or twice; near band: template default
source: the newest merged PR among the last 10 (params.last_n): gh pr list --label params.dependency_label --state merged, by mergedAt, then actions/runs?head_sha= and runs/{id}/jobs; the others beside it. A value read now, never a median

label: Install step time, latest main run
means: Seconds the slowest dependency install step took in the newest successful push run on main.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: an install with the package cache restored (setup-node's cache input) should take under a minute
source: latest: gh api actions/runs (or params.install_workflow's runs) and runs/{id}/jobs, the newest successful push run with an npm ci, pnpm install or yarn install step
